name: Stage Static State Salience 01
bounded_question: What neutral static luminance and internal-core contrast grammar best separates Rest, Listening, Current Opportunity and Speaking while every Character remains visibly present and no state implies emotion, rank, obligation or authority?
single_variable: static neutral cone salience expressed only through whole-beam luminance and internal-core contrast
authority_limits: The cone carrier and incumbent geometry are not candidates in STATE-S1.
No state may depend on color, motion, texture change, floor-pool geometry, spatial position or selection treatment.
Human-readable Character names and explicit state labels remain present in every specimen and forced-colors fallback.
Selection/focus leaves the cone materially unchanged; Wren's selected incumbent cone is treated as Rest for this state-only study.
Take a Seat, creator actions, rail/pips/arcs, performance/history geometry and implementation are outside this gate.
No outcome creates production luminance tokens, final palette, motion timing or Phase-C exit authority.

state_semantics.REST: Visible near-still presence; not inactive or de-emphasized out of the ensemble.
state_semantics.LISTENING: Readable receptive presence; must not be represented as simple inactivity or epistemic observation authority.
state_semantics.CURRENT_OPPORTUNITY: This Character may act; salience must not imply obligation, promise of speech or rank.
state_semantics.SPEAKING: The same carrier intensifies for current performance; it must not replace or visually erase the ensemble.

incumbent_geometry_control.derivation: Raster-measured visible cone envelopes from the exact incumbent master; frozen as comparison scaffolding and not promoted as production vector tokens.

neutral_shared_constants.floor_pool_geometry: fixed across all families and states

CREF.name: Historical Interaction Static Ladder
CREF.source_note: Uses the old Stage Cone Interaction opacity ordering after removing its geometry, pool-shape and motion changes.

CNEG.name: Flat Salience Negative Control
CNEG.expected_failure: All four states share the same optical signature and therefore cannot provide redundant visual separation.

F1.name: Compressed Presence Ladder
F1.risk: state separation may become too subtle at ensemble scale or narrow transfer

F2.name: Core-Led Salience Ladder
F2.risk: high core contrast may read like a software status lamp or make Speaking too punctate

F3.name: Envelope-Led Salience Ladder
F3.risk: whole-beam brightness may become a rank/status meter and Speaking may dominate the ensemble

F4.name: Balanced Dual-Channel Ladder
F4.risk: dual-channel increase may still overstate Opportunity or compress Opportunity/Speaking distinction

family_separation_law: F1 tests a deliberately compressed two-channel ladder.
F2 keeps whole-beam change restrained and moves most separation into the internal core.
F3 keeps the internal core fixed and moves separation into whole-beam luminance.
F4 distributes separation across both channels at moderate strength.
No family may change cone polygon, blur, falloff, floor-pool geometry, texture pattern, color or motion.
CREF and CNEG are calibration controls and cannot win.

matrix.five_character_pattern_note: Mirrors the incumbent Stage's Speaking/Listening/Selected/Current Opportunity/Listening distribution while treating Selection as cone-neutral Rest, as required by interaction law.
matrix.forced_colors_law: Decorative beams may disappear; human-readable Character names and explicit state labels must remain visible and unambiguous without horizontal overflow.
matrix.normal_mode_law: All families render neutral monochrome with identical geometry, blur, falloff, texture and floor treatment.

mechanical_falsifiers: Any family or state mutates a Character polygon, anchor, blur, falloff, floor-pool geometry or texture pattern.
Any candidate depends on non-neutral color, animation, transition or state-specific texture.
Any candidate gives two or more of the four states identical envelope/core signatures.
Any normal-mode cone becomes effectively absent because envelope_alpha <= 0.35.
Any forced-colors specimen loses Character name or explicit state text.
Any 320px specimen causes horizontal document overflow.
subjective_falsifiers: REST reads absent, deactivated or outside the living ensemble.
LISTENING reads as merely dimmed inactivity rather than present receptive participation.
CURRENT_OPPORTUNITY reads as obligation, guaranteed speech, rank or creator selection rather than may-act salience.
SPEAKING visually erases neighboring Characters or dominates the entire Stage rather than intensifying the same carrier.
The four states read as a generic software status meter, progress scale or social rank ladder instead of performance-state salience.
State differentiation depends on exact spatial position, color, motion, portrait recognition or hidden text.
The five-Character mixed-state specimen loses one-cone-per-Character ensemble readability.
The 320px transfer collapses state separation into indistinguishable brightness noise.

promotion_law.multiple_survivors: Apply the frozen evaluation_priority in order. An unresolved exact tie closes without a selected survivor rather than creating a result-aware hybrid.
promotion_law.promotion_scope: Any survivor is provisional neutral static state-salience evidence only and must later survive a separately frozen exact-incumbent Stage comparison before gaining Stage authority.

source_freeze.freeze_law: Complete source-only verification, then replace only the pending harness hash before the first visual/browser exposure. No family, geometry, state value or falsifier may change after exposure.

required_diagnostics: six families and twenty-four mixed-state specimens materialize
geometry is invariant by Character across family and state
candidate state signatures are unique and CNEG remains intentionally flat
forced-colors fallback retains labels and removes decorative state dependence
no horizontal overflow at either viewport

recursive_preflight_requirements: authority and state semantics remain intact
incumbent carrier geometry is not reopened
selection and Take a Seat remain excluded
CONE-S1/F2 closed-result law is not reopened
no production token or implementation claim is made
next_action: Materialize the deterministic neutral STATE-S1 harness and verifier from these frozen values; perform source-only audit and hash freeze before any visual exposure.
